name: Zael
source:
Zael was exiled from their home planet for daring to care about "lesser beings." Their home is technologically advanced, but the ruling family is insular and isolationist, preferring to ignore less-advanced species when possible, or destroying them if they become a nuisance.

[From in-game character profile]
